edits.text: PARTIES AND SUBJECT MATTER. This Agreement is between [Seller’s full legal name, entity type and jurisdiction] (Seller) and Meridian Acquisitions LLC (Buyer). Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, Seller shall sell and Buyer shall purchase [number and class] shares (Shares) of [target company’s full legal name, entity type and jurisdiction] (Company), representing [percentage]% of its issued and outstanding share capital. All bracketed matters require express agreement before execution.

1. PURCHASE PRICE AND PAYMENT. The proposed purchase price for the Shares is [currency and amount] (Purchase Price), subject to [expressly agreed adjustment mechanism, including definitions, calculation methods, reference accounts, preparation and review deadlines, and dispute-resolution process; or an express agreement that there will be no adjustment]. At Closing, Buyer shall pay [the Purchase Price/as adjusted under the agreed mechanism] by wire transfer of immediately available funds to Seller’s designated account, with any escrow, holdback or deferred consideration only as expressly agreed in writing. Payment and delivery shall be concurrent, and Buyer’s obligation to pay is conditioned upon delivery of good title to the Shares free of all liens and encumbrances and satisfaction or valid waiver of the agreed closing conditions. No price or payment or adjustment term is agreed by inclusion of this proposal.

2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days after signing on [specified date, time and place or remote exchange protocol], provided the agreed closing conditions are satisfied or validly waived, or on another date only by mutual written agreement. Closing conditions shall include [specified regulatory and third-party approvals], [agreed standard for accuracy of representations and performance of covenants], absence of any legal prohibition on Closing, and [other expressly agreed conditions]. Seller shall deliver duly executed share transfer instruments, applicable share certificates and agreed evidence of title and authority; Buyer shall deliver the payment required by Section 1 and agreed evidence of authority. Additional deliveries shall be specified in an agreed closing checklist. If Closing has not occurred by [outside date], [either party, subject to agreed restrictions on termination by a party whose breach caused the failure to close] may terminate by written notice. The parties shall expressly agree the consequences of termination, including treatment of accrued breach claims and surviving provisions. Neither the outside date nor any termination right is agreed until these terms are completed.

3. REPRESENTATIONS. Seller represents, subject to the expressly agreed disclosure standards and schedules, that the Company’s [identify audited annual and interim financial statements, dates, periods and accompanying notes] have been prepared in accordance with [specified accounting standard], consistently applied except as identified in the notes or agreed disclosures, and fairly present in all material respects the Company’s financial position and results for the dates and periods covered, subject, for interim statements, to [agreed treatment of normal year-end adjustments and omitted notes]. Seller further represents that it owns the Shares and will transfer good title to them at Closing free of all liens and encumbrances. Any additional qualifications, materiality or knowledge standards, and repetition of representations at Closing remain subject to express agreement. Disclosure schedules and the standard determining when a disclosure qualifies a representation must be agreed before execution; access to information alone shall have only the qualifying effect expressly agreed by the parties.

4. INDEMNITY. Subject to expressly negotiated disclosure standards, exclusions, procedures and limitations, Seller shall indemnify Buyer for [defined recoverable losses] arising from (a) breach of Seller’s representations or covenants and (b) liabilities of the Company arising from acts, omissions, events or circumstances occurring before Closing that were not disclosed in accordance with the agreed disclosure standard. The parties shall expressly agree the treatment of liabilities reflected or reserved in the financial statements, liabilities included in any purchase-price adjustment, contingent liabilities and matters identified in the disclosure schedules. The final provision shall specify covered persons and losses; survival and claim deadlines; any caps, baskets, thresholds and exceptions; mitigation and no-double-recovery rules; and the relationship to other remedies. Direct claims shall require written notice describing the basis and reasonably available supporting information, followed by an agreed response and dispute-resolution process. Third-party claims shall be subject to agreed notice requirements, defense-control rights and exceptions, cooperation duties, and consent protections for settlements, including those imposing admissions or nonmonetary obligations. The effect of delayed notice shall be expressly agreed. No limitation, exclusion, waiver or exclusive-remedy provision is agreed unless expressly set out in the executed Agreement.
Please confirm Seller and Company legal details, capitalization and the precise Shares being transferred. Bracketed terms throughout are unresolved drafting points, not agreed terms.

receiver.message_back: For Buyer, we propose the Company’s last three fiscal years’ audited financial statements and latest month-end interim statements, prepared consistently under US GAAP and fairly presenting its financial position, results and cash flows, with interim exceptions limited to immaterial normal year-end adjustments and omitted notes; disclosures must specifically identify the relevant representation and fairly describe the matter, with no qualification by data-room access alone. Seller should indemnify Buyer and the Company for reasonably incurred losses, liabilities and defense costs from breaches and undisclosed pre-Closing liabilities, with 24-month general survival, general claims capped at the Purchase Price without a basket, title, authority, tax and fraud claims outside that cap and surviving through applicable limitation periods, timely notified claims preserved until resolved, late notice prejudicing recovery only to the extent of actual prejudice, no double recovery, and no settlement imposing admissions or nonmonetary obligations without Buyer’s consent; all terms remain subject to agreement on price, schedules and the complete executed agreement.
